title: Dashboard v2 save: always strip resourceVersion before create/update branch
answers: Why does creating a dashboard fail with a resourceVersion conflict error on v2 API?
Dashboard save fails on create when resourceVersion is set
POST to dashboard API fails with resourceVersion field
How should resourceVersion be handled in dashboard save APIs?
body:
Symptom: Creating a new dashboard via the v2 API fails when the payload carries a resourceVersion (e.g. '0') from a stale/cloned object.
Root cause: saveDashboard only deleted obj.metadata.resourceVersion inside the `if (obj.metadata.name)` branch, so the create path (no name set, goes to POST) still sent resourceVersion and the backend rejected it. See public/app/features/dashboard/api/v2.ts:K8sDashboardV2API.saveDashboard.
Fix pattern: delete metadata.resourceVersion unconditionally before branching on update-vs-create, matching the v1 API's behavior (public/app/features/dashboard/api/v1.ts).
Constraints: Applies to any k8s-style resource save flow in this codebase that decides update(PUT) vs create(POST) based on metadata.name presence — resourceVersion must never be forwarded on create; only update legitimately needs it stripped-or-passed per backend semantics. Add a test asserting the create path's POST body lacks resourceVersion when adding similar logic elsewhere.
applies: Dashboard save APIs (and similar k8s-resource save wrappers) in public/app/features/dashboard/api/
